title: Wendell and the Gravity
author: Vesper Zhou
blurb: Wren Almeida, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
